entries.title: Crewmates on Windows see the pictures they read
entries.body: On Windows, a crewmate using any provider other than Claude now sees the PNG and JPEG files it reads, and the pictures attached to its messages. Before, each picture reached it only as a note saying the image was omitted because it could not be resized.
entries.noPicture: This changes what a crewmate receives when it reads a picture, not how any view looks.
